audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer and packet both give Xerath rows 1-4. The page rendered two answers to 'who wins Level 1'.
audit.why: Xerath's charged Arcanopulse (Q, 9/8/7/6/5s) outranges Neeko's Blooming Burst (800) and Tangle-Barbs (1000) before Pop Blossom exists, so the early rows belong to Xerath; from level 6 the disguise flank makes it a skill lane.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side moved to Xerath to agree with win[0..3]; rows 4-6 left as Skill where both layers already agree.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Lost Chapter makes the poke infinite, level 6 Rite of the Arcane (130/115/100s) converts chip into kills, Luden's turns Q-W into third-bars. Neeko's counter-spike is Pop Blossom at 6 (120/105/90s) with Shapesplitter disguise.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all, and the interaction that decides the lane (Blooming Burst re-blooming on champion hit; Pop Blossom being a leap your E must answer) was never stated.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and roots for longer after passing through a champion or minion kill; your Shocking Orb (E) is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s and is the only interrupt you own for her Pop Blossom leap. Blooming Burst blooms a second time on champion hit, so trading inside 800 units pays her twice for one cast.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull and dontsFull; the double-bloom and the E-for-R rule stated explicitly.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Eye of Destruction' in spikes[0].text as a probable wrong ability name. It is Xerath's real W name in the kit file — a false positive.

audit.whatIsWrong: 21 misgendering fields called Neeko 'he/his/him', and two bullets were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Neeko is she/her per champ-gender.js; the Do's/Don'ts bodies must explain their own titles.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields fixed; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their titles.
